csv_scope_of_work: The City of Hayward (City) Transportation Division is seeking proposals from qualified Civil Engineering Design Services Consultants to prepare project Plans, Specifications, and Estimates (PS&E) for the Downtown Bike Loop transportation infrastructure project at various downtown streets in the City of Hayward. To implement the Downtown Bike Loop improvements, the City is seeking a qualified Consultant to prepare construction documents for 5 downtown streets, listed below: City Center Dr (Foothill Blvd to 2nd St) 2nd St (City Center Dr to D St) B St (Montgomery St to Watkins St) C St (Main St to 2nd St) Watkins St (B St to Jackson St)

title: Design for Downtown Bike Loop
short_description: Design services for bicycle infrastructure improvements on five downtown streets in Hayward.
project_scope: Preparation of plans, specifications, and estimates for the Downtown Bike Loop transportation infrastructure project on five downtown streets: City Center Dr (Foothill Blvd to 2nd St), 2nd St (City Center Dr to D St), B St (Montgomery St to Watkins St), C St (Main St to 2nd St), and Watkins St (B St to Jackson St). The notice concerns urban bicycle and street improvement works; no bridge structures, spans, or building areas are stated.
services: Civil engineering design services to prepare PS&E/construction documents; requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, cost estimating, planning/master planning, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Urban bicycle/street infrastructure project without any bridge, roof, building, or special structural component stated.
- Scope is primarily civil/traffic design and PS&E for street improvements.
- Includes several disciplines, but no clear structural engineering challenge relevant to sbp.
- Falls close to pure streetscape/transportation design rather than sbp's core focus on bridges, long-span roofs, and special structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Available scope information: PS&E for bicycle infrastructure improvements on five downtown streets in Hayward; funding source noted as Alameda CTC VRF. No quantities, lengths, or cost breakdowns are provided, so a realistic USD estimate is not possible from the notice alone.
